ask_user_clarifying_question: ask the user a clarifying question with up to 4 predefined answer choices via the clarify_tool function
check_clarify_availability: check if the clarify tool has all requirements met by calling check_clarify_requirements
get_clarify_schema: get the OpenAI function-calling schema for the clarify tool from CLARIFY_SCHEMA
register_clarify_tool: register the clarify tool with the tool registry using registry.register with schema and handler
build_clarify_tool: build an interactive clarifying question tool supporting multiple-choice and open-ended user prompts
